name: The 19 WritingStyle records live before the reading passes began

terms.note: [UnderReview] Coined name (the skill's own example of what is not allowed). Original AI-authored corpus, already pulled for rework by the curator note. No body of work by named hands stands behind it, so there is nothing to credit. If reworked from real plain-language reports, it re-enters as a manifestation under Technical reports (LCGFT gf2015026093), a cell a later LCGFT pass creates. Archived 2026-09-08. Cell not yet created; attach when its LCGFT pass lands.

[UnderReview] One writer, honestly named, but the record contradicts itself: name and credits say the Casaubon translation (1634, Gutenberg 2680) while the corpus manifest labels all three excerpts 'Long translation, 1862'. The exemplar wording ('Betimes in the morning say to thyself') is Casaubon's, so fix the manifest labels. The old cell stoic-aphoristic-self-address is archived (B5 item 24); attach under Meditations (LCGFT gf2015026056), whose scope note reads devotional, so the fit is flagged uncertain; Sayings (gf2014026170) is the alternative. Defect recorded as a curator note 2026-09-08; manifest re-attached with the Meditations cell. Cell not yet created; attach when its LCGFT pass lands.
